title: 第十四章 赐婚第十五章 青狐妖
content_zh:
珍馐老仙表示：“能吃的都是老头留下的。”
霖华仙尊无语的说：“喂喂喂。你给我认真点，这些东西会威胁凡人生死的说。”
珍馐老仙认真看了看，把几个没见过的挑出来说：“这几个没见过，哦，我大概十几年才关注一下的说，这几个品质是新来的。”
霖华仙尊无语的把信息反馈下去，韩紫枫淡定的说：“殿下，通知你一个不幸的消息，食人鱼、小龙虾、蝙蝠都是最近入侵过来的，也就是说，这场虫灾，根本是人祸。现在怎么弄？这里清理还好办，但河流中必须清理，这些东西都会影响周围的生态环境。”
她沉默一下说：“就是说，会叫周围的动物、植物受到灭顶之灾。能明白我说什么吗？关键是，要抓到这个往河里丢这种危险品的，手贱的人。”
北空明淡定的吩咐侍卫去办那些事，这些有关民生，必须抓紧。紫枫冷不丁的来一句：“话说，都是乡里乡亲的，问问百姓有没有见到什么陌生人。”
有过这么个点子，很快，百姓就举报出一堆陌生人，护卫也无所谓，一点点的查就完事啦。眼看这里没了别的事情，他们就准备家走，北空明突然问一句：“你身边的那个婢女，你打算怎么处理？”
紫枫疑惑的问：“不是换人了吗？”
北空明一脸无奈的说：“之前那个叫翠儿的，不止一次，往我这里凑，新来的这个，好点有限。你家将军府的规矩，不行啊！”
紫枫开心一刀说：“那你问我没用，去问我家主母去，呵呵，你这个殿下也真是不值钱啊，想往你床上爬的，居然只有丫鬟，切。”
北空明顿时连更黑啦，紫枫开心问：“你想要做什么？”
北空明直接回答：“再爬打死就完事儿。”
紫枫开心的说：“去告状啊，学学你家老大。”
北空明说：“你就不怕父王，一怒，把将军府连坐？”
紫枫淡漠的回答：“我爹也是有军功的，更何况，后宅的事情，那是主母的问题，关整个将军府啥事？妾就是个妾，能有啥好想法？”
北空明有点诡异的看着紫枫，紫枫一脸看我干嘛的表情。回到京城，大皇子也回来啦，果然，玉米、地瓜、土豆，都已经到位，只是看着打算吃的大皇子，紫枫疑惑的问：“你这是要吃？”大皇子点头。
北空明补一句：“明年开春才能种子吧？”
紫枫无语的说：“不是，只要把芽捂出来，就能往地里种啦，在冬季的话，可以做一个棚，用布盖出一个棚，要保持，棚里的恒温，这样就可以种啦。原则上，一年四季，能种三季，就算现在没这个水平，两季也是可以的好吧。”
北空明顿时精明的问：“你确定？”
阿枫淡定的回答：“嗯，原则上，是可以的，但具体的，就叫花匠、农民，实验一下呗，就算失败，不就是几斤东西吗？但万一种活，明年，绝大多数人，就不会饿肚子啦。”

于是能说啥，从御花园开始种呗。北空明更是直接给上官武递去一封信，上面写着，叫他管管自家主母，一个个教出来的丫鬟，都是上面心比天高的性子。
这个家伙也挺狠的，直接盖上皇上的印玺，表示皇家很不开心。皇帝也知道这件事，只是，他这个皇帝，有点不太好插手，但将军府的人，确实改管管啦。
皇帝看着忙完的事情，他很中肯的评价：“老大，你不行啊！”
大皇子泪眼汪汪说：“父皇，那群西凉人骗我。”
一群人翻白眼啊，皇帝问紫枫：“丫头，你想要什么奖励？”
紫枫回答：“那您把我嫁给你家老三呗，哪怕结婚完，直接写休书都成，人家要的，只是结婚的过程哦！”
皇帝看看北空明问：“我家老三就叫你这么看不上？”
紫枫一摊手说：“首先，就将军府而言，咱也不是多受待见的，不然，我家丫头，都不能琢磨，接着我往上爬，黑锅还是我的。其次，皇家那种打打杀杀的事情，我也不想管。他们也肯定有他们的想法，所以把，我不打算这个三皇子正妃的名字能霸占多久，哪怕一天就成啊！”
皇帝疑惑：“女子出嫁后，被休就不好再嫁啦。”
紫枫一摊手说：“你就当咱修庙那个仙尊，给我的挑战课题而已，嫁就玩了，至于剩下的事情，呵呵，我还能跟这个世界呆多久，都不太好说的样子。”
皇帝想想，果断同意：“成。”
紫枫摸着下巴说：“皇帝啊，圣旨不着急，老三刚给我家主母上了眼药，估计这几天他们会很开心的找我的茬，我先玩两天，不行就揍一顿，你再准备办婚礼呗。”
皇帝表示：“行，你们俩不介意就行。”
紫枫想想，再次举手问：“提问：现在有机关师吗？”
北空明回答：“有，你想如何？”
紫枫淡定的回答：“我出机关图，你们找可信的人，弄着玩呗。但这种东西，相当危险，必须放在你们自己人的手里，不然出问题，那就太麻烦啦。这个，就是你们皇室的问题啦。”她摸着下巴说：“图的话，等过两天的吧。”
皇宫这边确定好，紫枫也就开开心心家走，她回家的路上，跟白莲花系统问：“有没有，热武器解刨图？枪支、火炮、飞机、自行车、摩托车、汽车、手机、电话、电脑等等。”
霖华仙尊看到这么一行行的东西，咆哮了：“你会不会太难为古人啦？”
紫枫淡定的回答：“配方给他们啦，能不能具现化出来，那就是他们的问题啦，啦啦啦啦啦。”
霖华仙尊汗一个，不过，算了，给就给，反正犯难的，绝对不是他。紫枫开心的把这些翻翻，随后，就等两天，把这些东西给皇帝，也就完事啦。别说，这里的真是啥都有，包括射程什么的，都是有的，还有爆炸后的程度，也都写的很清楚。

The old immortal of Zhen Gourmet said: "Everything that can be eaten is left by the old man."
Immortal Linhua said speechlessly: "Hey, hey, hey. Please be serious, these things will threaten the life and death of mortals."
The old immortal Zhenxiu looked at them carefully, picked out a few that he had never seen before, and said, "I haven't seen these ones before. Oh, I've only paid attention to them for about ten years, so these qualities are new."
Immortal Linhua silently fed back the information, and Han Zifeng said calmly: "Your Highness, I have some unfortunate news to inform you. Piranhas, crayfish, and bats have all invaded recently. In other words, this pest disaster is basically a man-made disaster. What should we do now? It's easy to clean up here, but it must be cleaned up in the river. These things will affect the surrounding ecological environment."
She was silent for a moment and said: "That is to say, it will cause great disaster to the surrounding animals and plants. Do you understand what I am saying? The key is to catch this mean person who threw such dangerous items into the river."
Beikong Ming calmly ordered the guards to do those things. These are related to people's livelihood and must be paid close attention to. Zifeng said abruptly: "By the way, they are all from the village. Ask the people if they have seen any strangers."
I had this idea, and soon the people reported a bunch of strangers, and the guards didn't care, they just checked a little bit and it was done. Seeing that there was nothing else going on here, they were preparing to leave home. Beikong Ming suddenly asked: "What are you going to do with the maid next to you?"
Zifeng asked doubtfully: "Didn't they change people?"
Beikong Ming said helplessly: "The one named Cui'er before came to me more than once. The new one is not good at all. The rules of your General's Mansion are not allowed!"
Zifeng happily said: "Then it's useless for you to ask me. Go ask my mistress. Haha, your highness is really worthless. The only one who wants to crawl into your bed is the maid."
Beikong Ming suddenly got darker, and Zifeng asked happily: "What do you want to do?"
Beikong Ming answered directly: "If you keep crawling and beating me to death, you'll be done."
Zifeng said happily: "Go and complain, learn from your boss."
Beikong Ming said: "Aren't you afraid that your father will seize the general's palace in anger?"
Zifeng replied indifferently: "My father also has military merit. What's more, the affairs of the back house are the mistress's problem. What does it have to do with the entire general's mansion? I am just a concubine, what good ideas can I have?"
Beikong Ming looked at Zifeng a little strangely, and Zifeng looked like he was looking at me. Back in the capital, the eldest prince also came back. Sure enough, the corn, sweet potatoes, and potatoes were all in place. Just looking at the eldest prince who was about to eat them, Zifeng asked doubtfully: "Are you going to eat it?" The eldest prince nodded.
Beikong Ming added: "The seeds can't be planted until spring next year, right?"
Zifeng said speechlessly: "No, just cover the buds and you can plant them in the ground. In winter, you can make a shed and cover it with cloth. You have to maintain a constant temperature in the shed, so you can plant. In principle, you can plant three seasons all year round. Even if you don't have this level now, two seasons is fine."
Beikong Ming immediately asked shrewdly: "Are you sure?"
Afeng replied calmly: "Well, in principle, it is possible, but specifically, let's ask gardeners and farmers to experiment. Even if it fails, isn't it just a few kilograms of food? But if it happens, next year, most people will not be hungry."
So what can I say, start planting from the Royal Garden. Beikong Ming even sent a letter directly to Shangguan Wu, which said, telling him to take care of his mistress. The maids he trained were all high-spirited.
This guy was also very cruel, and he directly stamped the emperor's seal to show that the royal family was very unhappy. The emperor also knew about this matter, but as an emperor, he was a bit reluctant to interfere, but the people in the general's palace did change their control.
The emperor looked at what he had finished and made a very pertinent comment:“老大，你不行啊！”
